description: A private life is a happy life! #careeradvice #lifebydesign #30something #bigsisteradvice
transcript: Having a private life put me light years ahead in my life and as a woman in My mid-30s. I learned very very very early the power of privacy. I don't share anything unless I want to within having a private life I've been able to live freely and Freedom is a gateway to success. I never feared failure I was not unsure of myself because I didn't give others the freedom to live in my world I didn't give others the freedom to take my different trials and or my wins and Give their opinions because I didn't care it didn't matter Learn how to keep your mouth closed. No one needs to know everything about you
